metadata.title: iSCORE-PD: scRNA-seq of WT WIBR3 hESC-derived dopaminergic neurons
metadata.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing of WIBR3 hESC-derived dopaminergic neurons differentiated for 35-37 days. Three biological replicates were independently differentiated and assayed via CellPlex-multiplexed 10x Chromium v3.1 scRNA-seq libraries.
